notes:
Pakistan administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01.  
  
This dataset is structured into 3 levels:  
- Admin 1: 7 Province or Territory  
- Admin 2: 160 District  
- Admin 3: 577 Tehsil  
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 27 September 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 09 September 2022: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 02 September 2022: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 02 September 2022: boundaries created by the source  
  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
